basics.name: Mateo Rossi
basics.label: Graphic Designer
basics.summary: Graphic designer with seven years in branding and campaigns for food, fashion and culture. I make identities that last and campaigns people stop for.

work.name: Studio Nove
highlights: Led 20 brand identities, from logo to packaging, for clients including a 40-store bakery chain.
Designed a museum exhibition campaign that sold 120,000 tickets, a record for the venue.

work.name: Moda Lab
work.summary: In-house team at a fashion retailer.
highlights: Designed seasonal campaigns across print, store windows and social media for 60 stores.
Built the brand's first design system for its online shop.
